text: 申通快递公告，申通快递股份有限公司于2026年8月4日召开第六届董事会第二十二次会议，审议通过了《关于终止向不特定对象发行可转换公司债券事项并撤回申请文件的议案》，同意公司终止本次向不特定对象发行可转换公司债券事项并向深圳证券交易所申请撤回相关申请文件。
text_en: Shentong Express announced that Shenzhen Shentong Express Co., Ltd. held the 22nd meeting of the Sixth Board of Directors on August 4, 2026, approving the proposal to terminate the issuance of convertible corporate bonds to unspecified investors and withdraw the application documents, agreeing to halt the issuance and apply to the Shenzhen Stock Exchange to withdraw the relevant application materials.
